text:
Mira: Heads-up 5 preview customers go live tomorrow. Need coverage for kickoff calls, survey pipeline, and renewal-risk tagging.
Owen: I can take 11am PT and 2pm PT kickoffs.
Luis: Ill build the short survey (NPS + 3 quick flags). Draft: https://forms.redwood/preview-quick. Add latency-sensitivity and an integration blocker freeform?
Mira: Yes keep it under 5 questions. Freeform must capture reproducible steps if they report integration issues.
Alex: Infra will enable verbose telemetry for new tenants for first 48h to capture cold starts; expect ~15% more log egress.
Sasha: Ill run EMEA enablement at 6pm CET. Need one-pager and example prompts plus rate-limit guidance.
Mira: Owen/Sasha split the one-pager: product flows vs ops limits. Share by EOD.
Owen: Will open a PR: https://git.redwood/preview/onepager.md (WIP).
Luis: For ingestion: tag survey rows with account_id and cohort_tag, then push to kafka://redwood.preview.feedback.v1
Alex: deploy-bot schedule: toggle telemetry verbose for preview cohort at 2026-05-12T15:00Z for 48h.
deploy-bot: Telemetry toggle scheduled by Alex: starts 2026-05-12T15:00Z, duration 48h.
Mira: Renewal-risk auto-flag criteria? Need to surface to CSMs before demo week.
Luis: Suggest auto-flag if NPS <=5 OR mentions latency OR mentions integration blocker. Tag = "preview-risk-low".
Sasha: Also flag if they miss enablement twice.
Owen: Ill add an "enablement-missed" internal tag when no-shows occur.
Mira: Schedule a 15-min triage after day 3 for flagged accounts; invite CSMs + ENG oncall.
Alex: Added runbook snippet: check variant routing, KV cache hits, collect prompts, escalate if p50 > 350ms.
Luis: Weekly CSV report to cs-ops & product: account_id,nps,issues,flagged. Include timezone and contact window.
Sasha: Calendar invite created for EMEA enablement: https://calendar.redwood/event/preview-emea-enable
Owen: One-pager draft pushed. Added batching recommendation per request.
Luis: Survey + ingestion wired and tagged, pushed to Kafka.
Alex: Telemetry toggle scheduled and oncall pinged. Dashboard cohort filter + p90>500ms alert created.
Mira: Thanks all. Ill set the day-3 triage invite once enrollments confirmed. Post-week debrief Friday 10am PT. Flag urgent issues in #customer-success or DM me. :pray:
